availability.note: Live Build & Price line 'MGS6 EV Essence RWD' (price 49990); exactly two variant lines in the configurator, matching CarExpert/CarsGuide/EV Central launch coverage (Essence RWD and Essence AWD only).

listPrice.note: No list price published. Configurator variant price field is 49990 and its display shows $49,990 struck through with $48,990* as 'Drive Away Price, Offer ends 31 December' (a $1,000 cashback on MGS6 EV for sales/deliveries 01 Nov-31 Dec 2026: campaign, not used). $49,990 is MG's regular national drive-away (CarExpert review and news, CarsGuide, Chasing Cars and EV Central all call it drive-away; MG model page says 'from $49,990 driveaway'). Back-out: (49990 - 958.80) / 1.042 = 47,055; round-trip driveAwayPrice(47130) = 49,989.46. Independent check against MG's own per-state on-road 'discounts' in the configurator data: VIC discount is $4,674.90 (RWD) vs $4,952.10 (AWD), a $277.20 gap = 33 Victorian duty units of $8.40 per $200; NSW gap $335 = 5% marginal duty on ~$6,700. Metallic paint (+$700) moves VIC by $25.20 (3 units) and NSW by $35 (5% of $700) on both grades, confirming the discounts are duty-driven. Together these put the dutiable-value gap at about $6,600-6,700, against a backed-out list gap of $6,718 and a drive-away gap of $7,000, so the back-out is consistent to within ~$100. Flat national drive-away may bundle dealer delivery, so list may overstate by an unknown amount. Re-derived 2026-11-27 for VIC rego $958.80 (was 47,130 at $880; round trip 49990.11).

batteryKwh.note: EV Database: usable 74.3 kWh, nominal 77.0 kWh NMC (same 77 kWh NCM pack MG AU quotes, unlabelled = gross/nominal). Chasing Cars also states 74.3 kWh usable.

rangeKm.note: MG AU brochure spec table 'Driving Range: WLTP Combined Cycle (km)' 530 on 20-inch 245/50 R20 wheels; same table gives NEDC 605 (rejected). EU WLTP on EV Database is also 530 km, so AU is not above the WLTP best case.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: EV Database WLTP 'Rated Consumption' 166 Wh/km (official manufacturer figure incl. charging losses) for the EU car with the same 530 km WLTP range; sits ~18% above battery/range (14.0). MG AU publishes only an NEDC efficiency (145 Wh/km), not used. Replaces the held derived value, resolving the watchlist backlog item.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: MG AU brochure 'Boot Volume Seats In Place (L)' 581, repeated by CarExpert, Chasing Cars and EV Central; measurement method not stated. MG UK quotes 674 L for the same car, which Carwow says is measured to the roof; EV Database lists 493 L. 581 kept as the manufacturer's AU figure; frunk not added (86 L (brochure) / 124 L (configurator blurb)).

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: MG AU brochure 'Boot Volume Seats Folded (L)' 1690 (UK/EV Database 1910 to the roof).

seats.note: 5 seats; MG AU brochure lists 40/60 rear folding seat with three rear 3-point belts.

towKg.note: MG AU brochure 'Maximum Towing Weight Braked (kg)' 1500 (unbraked 750).

warrantyYears.note: Standard 7 years/unlimited km; 10 years/250,000km only with service-activated extension (conditional, in pros). HV battery 7 years/150,000 km on MG's page (CarExpert says 160,000; manufacturer preferred).
